name: koishi-plugin-chatluna-request-meter
description: Observe ChatLuna request body size and warn before provider limits (works with every adapter).

scripts.test: node test/measure.test.cjs && node test/offload.test.cjs && node test/meter.test.cjs

description.zh: 观测 ChatLuna 每个模型请求的请求体体积（尤其是 base64 图片），在接近供应商上限时告警，可选超限直接拦截。挂在 ModelRequester.post 上，DeepSeek / 千问 / OpenAI / MiMo 等全部适配器通用。
description.en: Measure every ChatLuna model request body (especially inline base64 images), warn when approaching provider limits, and optionally block oversized requests. Patched at ModelRequester.post so it works for all adapters.
